english.title: Land, sell, expose, offer or possess for the purpose of sale, lobster with spawn attached to tail / exterior
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in contravention of an order made by the

(A)_[Secretary of State,]_
(B)_[Welsh Ministers,]_

(C)_[landed]_
(D)_[sold]_
(E)_[exposed or offered for sale]_
(F)_[possessed for the purpose of sale]_

a lobster which was

(G)_[carrying spawn]_
(H)_[in such a condition as to show that, at the time when it was taken, it was carrying spawn]_

attached to the tail or some other exterior part of the lobster
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17(3) and (4) of the Sea Fisheries (Shellfish) Act 1967.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened an order by the appropriate national authority
landed/sold/exposed/offered for sale/possessed for the purpose of sale in part of the UK to which the order related
lobster carrying spawn attached to the tail/other exterior part of the lobster OR
which was in such a condition as to show that at the time it was taken, it was carrying spawn attached

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For appropriate national authority refer to section 17(3ZA) of the Sea Fisheries (Shellfish) Act 1967.
(ii) Section 17(3B) of the Sea Fisheries (Shellfish) Act 1967 provides that any person who lands any lobster falling within subsection (3) of this section shall not be guilty of an offence under that subsection if (a) the lobsters were taken from that part of the sea that is within British fishery limits and does not include the Scottish zone or the Northern Ireland zone, (b) the person has been granted authority by the appropriate body to take such lobsters for the purpose of scientific investigation, and (c) the lobsters were taken for that purpose and in accordance with such authority.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
